name: Planet Forge [STELLAR UPDATE]
desc:
👍Like and favourite this game to support developer!

💥 Take control of your own planet! Expand your planet and collect different gases for an atmosphere. 

🌿 You can create life on a planet!!
🧪 Create own atmosphere with different gasses
🧊 Freeze or heat your planet! Throw asteroids in space and much more! 🔥
